golden_issues.problem: The corpus holds two Popular Book Co. AEON Shah Alam receipts from 06/03/18 three minutes apart - X51006008092 (Total RM 30.70, 18:01) and X51006008093 (Total RM 12.15, 18:04). 'The one at AEON Shah Alam' is therefore under-specified; the gold silently assumes the 30.70 slip. Verified by reading both images.

Same ambiguity as rcpt-e-09-typed: two AEON Shah Alam Popular receipts exist on 06/03/18 (30.70 and 12.15), so the comparison against Empire's 30.50 has two defensible readings. The gold's 30.70 / 30.50 figures are themselves correct per the images.

The AA Pharmacy receipt X51005719823 prints a 'CASH' mode header near the top while the tender block reads TOTAL 46.20 / MASTER 46.20 / CHANGE 0.00. The gold ('went on the card') follows the tender line and is right, but the file is internally contradictory and should get a human pass before this item is promoted to gold.

The question asks only 'which shop', but key_facts carries both the shop and the 5.35 amount, forcing a fully responsive answer ('99 SPEED MART S/B') down to partial. Several golds bundle unasked-for facts this way (see also rcpt-a-03, rcpt-b-07, rcpt-e-07); key_facts should be scoped to what the question actually requests.

On comparison items the key_facts are the two supporting amounts (7.95, 6.35) rather than the selection itself, so an answer that names the right bill scores zero facts. Comparison golds should carry the chosen item as a key fact. Same shape at rcpt-b-10, rcpt-c-09, rcpt-e-09 and rcpt-d-10 (where rcpt-d-10 does correctly list 'AA PHARMACY' first).
